package rulefixtures

import "time"

// scenario for test_fixture_builders_live_in_production_packages: Fixture and factory helpers defined in non-test production files.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.
type User struct {
	ID        int
	Name      string
	Email     string
	CreatedAt time.Time
}

func NewTestUser() *User {
	return &User{
		ID:        1,
		Name:      "testuser",
		Email:     "test@example.com",
		CreatedAt: time.Now(),
	}
}

func NewTestUserWithName(name string) *User {
	return &User{
		ID:        99,
		Name:      name,
		Email:     name + "@example.com",
		CreatedAt: time.Now(),
	}
}

func NewTestOrder() *Order {
	return &Order{
		ID:     100,
		UserID: 1,
		Total:  42.99,
	}
}

type Order struct {
	ID     int
	UserID int
	Total  float64
}
